note: This run proposes no runtime behaviour change, so it needs no arm ablation. The gates below cover the four proposals that touch anything executable. The scaffold's legacy arm names (vanilla/core/core-router/core-router-enforcement) are retired: the promoted architecture is lite/standard/critical with the verification loop (Stable 0.4.0).

gates.gates: P0 fixture-leak repair (medi-ny build_sample.py provenance docstring)
gates.pass_condition: admission PASS with reference=100, reference-alt=100, before-parser negative control=27 in band [15,40], grader isolation 8/8 under the hostile battery

gates.gates: P0 fixture-leak repair - does the measured delta survive?
gates.design: re-run one vanilla trial and one vanilla-loop trial on the repaired fixture
gates.pass_condition: vanilla stays at ~77 and the guided loop still reaches 100. If the loop collapses toward vanilla, the earlier result was partly measuring the leaked hint and the verification-loop claim must be re-scoped.
gates.blocks: any external publication of the 100/100/100 result as a clean shadow-replay

gates.gates: MC-01 (haiku effort) - settle the argument from omission
gates.design: one API call: model=claude-haiku-4-5 with effort=low; observe HTTP 400 versus silently ignored
gates.pass_condition: outcome recorded either way. 400 -> resolve_capability_profile must omit effort for selectors declaring effort_support.supported=false, plus a regression test. Ignored -> catalog note only, no code change.
gates.blocks: MC-01's code change; the catalog patch's effort_support metadata is authored either way but only ENFORCED after this call

gates.command: deterministic model-profile suite + tools/agentic.ps1 model-recommend across every provider x profile pair
gates.pass_condition: 10/10 model-profile cases still pass including risk-floor and incompatible-selector rejection; every provider x profile pair resolves; an expired catalog still blocks automation (automation_allowed=false)

gates.gates: P1 documentation edits (external citations, scope sentence) and the KB web_search correction
gates.pass_condition: zero broken cross-references in the package; infrastructure gate 15/15; every added citation resolves to a live URL

outstanding_obligation.statement: The verification loop was tuned and evaluated on the same task family (medi-ny). Under the cited critique, harness gains evaluated on the tuning benchmark risk overfitting to that task set.
outstanding_obligation.answered_half: The matched-budget search baseline the paper demands is ANSWERED from existing paid data: best-of-3 vanilla = 77 at ~883k tokens versus a single guided loop = 100 at 647k-1.21M. The loop's gain is not extra search at equal spend.
outstanding_obligation.outstanding_half: Replication on a SECOND task family. Until then the loop's generalisation is asserted, not measured. This is the single largest open item in the benchmark program.

cost_controls: No paid call in this plan is authorized; each needs separate explicit owner approval with an exact call count.
EV-02 and EV-03 are independent: EV-03 is one call settling a live automation defect; EV-02 is 1-3 calls settling fixture validity.
Any new campaign inherits the standing rules: admission gate, canary-first for unpaid fixtures, >=3 trials per arm for any verdict, every loop iteration counted as a call, Evals/local/STOP honoured.
